description: This PHP class, UpgraderConfigUtility, provides utility functions for checking the status of a database during an upgrade process within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It verifies database connection and schema state to determine if an upgrade can proceed.

classes.name: UpgraderConfigUtility
classes.description: Utility class that provides methods to verify database connection and schema status for the upgrade process within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: checkDatabaseStatus
methods.description: Checks if the table 'ohrm_upgrade_status' exists in the database, indicating the current upgrade status.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a Doctrine DBAL connection instance through a static method.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object to interact with database schema, used for verifying table existence.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Establishes a database connection and throws an exception if it encounters an error or if the upgrade status indicates a failure.
